behavior: An opportunistic omnivore that swims, dips for aquatic prey, scavenges, and forages on the ground for worms and insects. Often nests colonially and is mainly migratory.
field_marks: Small, slender gull with a rounded head and long wings
White head and underparts; light brown head streaking in nonbreeding plumage
Short, tapered greenish-yellow bill, sometimes with a dusky winter smudge
Dark eye and slender, dull yellow-green legs
Black wingtips with bold white spots; otherwise white tail
habitat: Breeds around wetlands, marshes, meadows, beaches, and other sites near water; winters along coasts and other waterside habitats, often also feeding in fields.
